hero.description: DEEPROOTS is more than a blockchain. It's a movement built on purpose, people, and principles.

intro.title: Code of Honor
intro.description: The values that guide everything we create, protect, and grow.

principles.title: Respect over ego
principles.description: We build with humility. We listen more than we speak.

principles.title: Truth over hype
principles.description: We don't chase trends. We commit to real value.

principles.title: Community over control
principles.description: Power belongs in the hands of people, not platforms.

principles.title: Transparency over perfection
principles.description: We'd rather show progress than pretend polish.

principles.title: Creativity over conformity
principles.description: Innovation requires freedom — and bold thinking.

principles.title: Ownership over permission
principles.description: Everyone deserves access. Everyone deserves control.

principles.title: Consistency over chaos
principles.description: We keep showing up. Even when no one's watching.

pledges.title: Our Pledge
pledges.quote: Honor is not branding. It's behavior.
pledges.subtext: It's how we treat each other — and what we're willing to defend.

final_section.title: If You Build Here, You Share This Code
final_section.description: Anyone who builds on DEEPROOTS is part of this code. It's not enforced by rules — it's led by example.
